bio.text: According to her campaign website, Cynthia "Cinde" Wirth, a Democrat from Columbus, Indiana, is a candidate for Indiana's 6th Congressional District, after previous congressional campaigns in 2022 and 2024.

Her campaign website says she taught biology and environmental science at Columbus Signature Academy for more than 10 years, served as a science and education expert for the U.S. House of Representatives in 2018-19, and has owned a community business for more than 20 years.
According to the same site, she earned a B.A. from the University of Evansville in 1992, an M.A. from Indiana University in 2009, and a Ph.D. from Ball State University in 2025.
